crm_notes:
Summary: Mid-market customer (SaaS support platform) evaluating Redwood Hosted API for primary chat-based support agent use. Primary goal: replace/augment live agents with AI assistants; streaming required. Target SLO: <1.5s first-token (95th pct) for customer-facing chat; throughput ~20-40 req/s during peak for one region. Initial ask: 2-week POC on Hosted API focused on latency and correctness, then pricing/term conversation for Dedicated if SLO met.

Technical requirements: streaming with low TTF (first-token), support for tool-calling to trigger Zendesk macros and internal ticket creation, structured output (JSON) for downstream routing, prefix caching to reduce cost for repeated user contexts, and per-route observability. Interested in quantization recommendations and batch sizing guidance for cost control.

Security/compliance: require SSO (SAML) for admins, SOC2 compliance evidence, audit logs retention 1 year, KMS integration for customer keys, data residency options for EU customers in future.

POC plan: 2-week latency-focused POC. Week 1: integrate streaming SDK and tool-calls, run synthetic load (20-40 rps) measuring 1st-token latency 50/95/99. Week 2: shadow traffic in production for subset of customers (non-critical flows). Success criteria: 95th percentile first-token <1.5s under synthetic + shadow load, stable token cost within budget, tool-calls executed reliably (<2s end-to-end).

Commercial/people: Head of Product (quote): "response needs to be indistinguishable from human response time — sub-1.5s is table stakes." AE Jordan Kim driving deal; SE Priya Patel owns POC. Requested Dedicated pricing sheet and commitment options for Dedicated capacity (monthly commit for 25 req/s baseline). Estimated ARR if move to Dedicated: $50-150k.

Open items: security FAQ questions to be answered (Drive link), Dedicated pricing and burst policy clarification, exact SLA wording for Hosted streaming paths.
